==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Salmon|Salmon]]
*250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] water
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure== 
#Put your salmon in a pot.
#Add the boiling water and sprinkle with salt.
#Cover the pot, and steam over low heat until the flesh is just cooked.
